<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" version="24.0.0"> <diagram name="C3 - Mobile App Components" id="ticketwave-c3-mobile"> <mxGraphModel dx="1400" dy="1000" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1250" pageHeight="1240" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<!-- ===== Container boundary ===== --> <mxCell id="boundary" value="Mobile App
[Container: Flutter]" style="rounded=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#1A365D;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 8;verticalAlign=bottom;align=left;fontColor=#1A365D;fontStyle=1;spacingLeft=14;spacingBottom=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="150" width="1010" height="820" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Layer bands ===== --> <mxCell id="bandApp" value="Application / bootstrap" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#b3b3b3;dashed=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#888888;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="175" width="970" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bandPres" value="Presentation" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#b3b3b3;dashed=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#888888;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="305" width="970" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bandDom" value="Domain" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#b3b3b3;dashed=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#888888;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="440" width="970" height="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bandData" value="Data" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#b3b3b3;dashed=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#888888;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="570" width="970" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bandCore" value="Core / infrastructure" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#b3b3b3;dashed=1;verticalAlign=top;align=left;fontStyle=2;fontColor=#888888;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="80" y="705" width="970" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Person ===== --> <mxCell id="cust_h" value="" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#08427B;strokeColor=#073B6F;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="540" y="10" width="42" height="42" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cust_b" value="<b>Customer</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Person]</font><br><br>Searches, buys, and manages tickets from the app." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#08427B;strokeColor=#073B6F;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=8;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="461" y="45" width="200" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Application / bootstrap ===== --> <mxCell id="boot" value="<b>App Bootstrap &amp; DI</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: main.dart / MultiProvider]</font><br><br>Loads prefs, builds the ApiClient, injects providers, sets theme and routes." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="100" y="205" width="420" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="router" value="<b>Router</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: onGenerateRoute]</font><br><br>Maps routes to pages; passes arguments (eventId, orderId, ticketId)." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="560" y="205" width="450" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Presentation ===== --> <mxCell id="pages" value="<b>UI Pages &amp; Widgets</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: Flutter Widgets]</font><br><br>Search, Event detail, Seat selection, Checkout, My tickets, Profile, Notifications, Promotions; MainShell nav." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="100" y="330" width="440" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="prov" value="<b>State Providers</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: provider · ChangeNotifier]</font><br><br>Auth, Event, Order, Ticket, Payment. Hold UI state, call use cases, notify widgets." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="580" y="330" width="430" height="85" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Domain ===== --> <mxCell id="uc" value="<b>Use Cases</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: Dart]</font><br><br>Login, SearchEvents, PurchaseTicket, ProcessPayment, GetNotifications, GetPromotions." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="100" y="465" width="440" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dom" value="<b>Entities &amp; Repository Contracts</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: Dart]</font><br><br>User, Event, Ticket, Seat, Payment, Promotion; abstract repository interfaces." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="580" y="465" width="430" height="75" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Data ===== --> <mxCell id="repo" value="<b>Repository Implementations</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: Dart]</font><br><br>Implement contracts; map DTOs to entities; wrap failures." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="100" y="598" width="300" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ds" value="<b>Remote Data Sources</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: Dart]</font><br><br>Per-feature; build requests and call the API Client." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="430" y="598" width="300" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="models" value="<b>Models / DTOs</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: Dart]</font><br><br>JSON (de)serialization of API payloads." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="598" width="250" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Core / infrastructure ===== --> <mxCell id="api" value="<b>API Client</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: Dio]</font><br><br>GET/POST/PUT/DELETE; ApiResponse &amp; PagedResponse; error mapping." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="100" y="733" width="300" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="intc" value="<b>Auth Interceptor</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: Dio Interceptor]</font><br><br>Attaches the Bearer JWT to requests; handles 401." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="430" y="733" width="300" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="store" value="<b>Local Storage</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Component: SharedPreferences]</font><br>JWT token &amp; user session" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;fillColor=#438DD5;strokeColor=#2E6DA4;fontColor=#ffffff;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="775" y="730" width="220" height="88" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== External container ===== --> <mxCell id="gw" value="<b>API Gateway + Waiting Room</b><br><font style='font-size:9px'>[Container: Spring Cloud Gateway]</font><br><br>Entry point to the TicketWave backend." style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1168BD;strokeColor=#0E5A9E;fontColor=#ffffff;arcSize=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="440" y="1010" width="290" height="95" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Title ===== --> <mxCell id="title" value="Component diagram for TicketWave Events — Mobile App [Flutter]" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#333333;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="1140" width="900" height="24" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" value="Clean Architecture (feature-based): Presentation → Domain → Data, over shared Core infrastructure. Provider for state, Dio for HTTP." style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#777777;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="1164" width="1000" height="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- ===== Relationships ===== --> <mxCell id="c1" value="Interacts with<br>[touch]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="cust_b" target="pages"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell>
<mxCell id="c2" value="Creates &amp; injects" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="boot" target="prov"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c3" value="Creates" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="boot" target="api"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c4" value="Configures" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="boot" target="router"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell>
<mxCell id="c5" value="Routes to" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="router" target="pages"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c6" value="Watches / calls" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="pages" target="prov"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c7" value="Invokes" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="prov" target="uc"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c8" value="Persists session in" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="prov" target="store"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell>
<mxCell id="c9" value="Depends on contracts" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="uc" target="dom"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c10" value="Uses repository" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="uc" target="repo"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c11" value="Implements" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontColor=#6a4a8a;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="repo" target="dom"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell>
<mxCell id="c12" value="Fetches via" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="repo" target="ds"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c13" value="Maps DTOs" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="repo" target="models"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c14" value="Sends requests via" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="ds" target="api"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c15" value="Deserializes into" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="ds" target="models"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell>
<mxCell id="c16" value="Runs requests through" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="api" target="intc"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell> <mxCell id="c17" value="Reads JWT from" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="intc" target="store"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell>
<mxCell id="c18" value="Makes API calls to<br>[JSON/HTTPS]" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=open;startArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#707070;fontColor=#404040;fontSize=9;" edge="1" parent="1" source="api" target="gw"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /></mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
